businesses.identity: Maroon display front with mustard circle frieze, narrow left door and red/orange textiles.
observed: Red-brown brick, three upper rows of three windows, flat parapet (no projecting bracket cornice). Mustard/cream checkerboard spandrel panels below each upper window, dark flat lintels, brown/red central escape.

Maroon storefront fascia has a repeated row of small cream/mustard circles between pale bands, not one central oval sign. Narrow shop entry at left, broad red-framed display center, separate dark residential entry at far right. Colorful red/orange cloth and small merchandise visible in display.
unknown: Tiny storefront lettering and residential number unreadable; fine textile/artifact inventory not resolved.
Exact finish, fine product inventory and font identity are not measured.

businesses.identity: Scaffold-obscured pale metal glazing, taped paperwork and plywood perimeter.
observed: 119 is fully covered by metal scaffold and dark safety netting, with green sidewalk shed and angled green/timber edge protection. Contractor board explicitly says 119 1 AVE. Red/brown masonry and central fire escape show through mesh. Lower storefront has pale framing, boarded panes and a dark-blue door; a separate narrow dark entrance is at the right edge.
Projecting shed includes upward/inward angled timber guard supports at exposed side, separate from horizontal green fascia and metal scaffold.
unknown: Mesh obscures reliable complete upper-opening counts and ornament; old tenant record is not current visible lettering.
Exact finish, fine product inventory and font identity are not measured.

businesses.identity: Teal laundry fascia, pale aluminum framing, multi-pane transoms and taped window notices.
observed: 121 red-brick facade has three upper floors, each with three dark-framed rectangular sash windows. Lowest upper row has triangular pediment hoods; higher rows layered flat lintels. Deep bracketed dark stone cornice. Dark-teal COSMO'S LAUNDERAMA fascia over cream framing and transoms. Separate pale residential glazed leaf at far right. Small 121 is on right end of fascia.

Detail reinspection: upper sash has high transom and split lower panes; lowest row has solid layered triangular pediment hoods, other rows molded bracket lintels. Teal fascia includes SELF SERVICE / DROP OFF SERVICE subline, 121 at right; pale residential door to right of shop. Shop window carries several small colored posters/labels; unseen laundry interior is not inferred.
unknown: Car hides shop thresholds and lower panels; full door-number text on transom unresolved.
Exact finish, fine product inventory and font identity are not measured.

businesses.identity: Cream fascia with broad red COMPTON’S lettering, scripted subline, bright stacked product panel and red bench.
observed: 123 is the matching red-brick three-by-three facade immediately north/right of 121, with pediment hoods on the lowest upper row, flat layered upper lintels and ornate bracket cornice. Ivory COMPTON'S fascia with red lettering and Sandwich Shop secondary line; small 123 in green oval at right. Broad shop glazing and narrow residential entrance on right.

Detail reinspection: same layered brownstone hoods as 121; lowest pediments are solid, not open triangular bars. Cream fascia COMPTON’S with Sandwich Shop subline; green oval 123 at far right. Tall narrow multi-row product display along right glazing; red metal bench in front.
unknown: People/tree and adjacent shed obscure exact right-door panel division and threshold.
Exact finish, fine product inventory and font identity are not measured.

businesses.identity: Nudibranch pale framed multiple glass leaves under dated shed, understated dark transom lettering.
observed: 125 is behind full-height black netting and scaffold; green shed with angled timber edge protection. Contractor board reads 125 1st Ave. Cream-painted lower framing, separate paired shop sections with small black nudibranch panels.
Projecting shed includes upward/inward angled timber guard supports at exposed side, separate from horizontal green fascia and metal scaffold.
unknown: Upper window count, cornice and door-number placement obscured by netting/tree; exact ground doors need adjacent inspection.

businesses.identity: Cream storefront and dark transoms beneath the construction shed; lower details partly hidden.

unknown: Netting conceals reliable full upper count and cornice. Entry number and narrow-shop identity unreadable.
